channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Quaest: No 1º turno do DF, Lula tem 28% e Flávio Bolsonaro, 26%, e estão empatados tecnicamente
item.description: A Quaest poll shows a technical tie between Lula (28%) and Flávio Bolsonaro (26%) in the presidential race among voters in the Federal District. The three-percentage-point margin of error indicates the difference falls within the statistical range, resulting in a technical tie in the first round in the DF.

item.title: Veja o que é #FATO e o que é #FAKE na sabatina de Romeu Zema a 'O Globo', 'Valor' e CBN
item.description: The Fato ou Fake fact-check column reviews statements made by Romeu Zema (Novo) during a roundtable interview with O Globo, Valor and CBN. His claim about Brazil's dependence on diesel and gasoline imports was labeled #FATO (true), supported by ANP data showing increased imports in 2025. However, his assertion that there were no scandals or fraud during his administration was debunked and tagged #FAKE, citing the Federal Police's Operation Rejeito, which uncovered a corruption scheme involving fraudulent environmental licenses for mining operations in Minas Gerais.

item.title: Economista da campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro propõe PEC fiscal e corte de 10 ministérios
item.description: Daniella Marques, economist advising Flávio Bolsonaro's 2026 presidential campaign, unveiled an economic agenda focused on overhauling Brazil's fiscal framework through a constitutional amendment during the transition period and creating a Superior Fiscal Governance Council. She also proposed cutting ten ministries and trimming commissioned positions, while criticizing the Judiciary and Congress as the most expensive per capita in the world.

item.title: PEC da Segurança: relator decide manter texto da Câmara para acelerar aprovação no Senado
item.description: The rapporteur of the Public Security Constitutional Amendment (PEC) in the Senate, Rogério Carvalho (PT-SE), announced he will keep the text approved by the Chamber of Deputies intact, with no changes, to speed up the process and allow direct promulgation. The proposal, President Lula's main bet for the area, toughens rules against organized crime and provides for asset seizure, but allies admit approval may be delayed until after the elections, with priority now given to ending the 6x1 work schedule.

item.title: Em Pernambuco Lula tem 54% no 1º turno e Flávio Bolsonaro, 19%, aponta Quaest
item.description: A Quaest poll shows President Lula leading the presidential race in Pernambuco in the first round, with 54% of voting intentions. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is second with 19%, indicating a significant gap in favor of the PT incumbent in the state.

item.title: Clariana Barão diz ter valores da direita, mas rejeita extremismo
item.description: Clariana Barão, a presidential candidate for the Democracia Cristã party in Mato Grosso, stated she holds right-wing values but rejects the extremism she says has taken over that political field. She claimed the polarization between PT supporters and Bolsonaro allies is tiring voters, while acknowledging achievements from both administrations. Regarding Flávio Bolsonaro, she said she does not see in him the simplicity and humility she attributes to former president Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Benedito Gonçalves toma posse como novo corregedor no CNJ
item.description: Benedito Gonçalves was sworn in as national justice ombudsman, succeeding Mauro Campbell Marques, pledging to act with prudence and balance in overseeing judges. In his speech, Luiz Felipe Salomão praised his 2022 TSE performance defending democracy; the magistrate requires Senate approval to assume the position.

item.title: Relator quer aprovar PEC da Segurança no Senado sem alterações
item.description: The rapporteur of the Public Security Constitutional Amendment, Rogério Carvalho (PT-SE), decided not to amend the text approved by the Chamber, only to accelerate the proceedings and avoid returning to the house. The strategy aims to enact the reform as soon as possible, further tension between the federal government and the Senate.

item.title: Flávio tem 45% contra 20% de Lula no 1º turno em SC, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Quaest poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 45% against Lula's 20% in the first round in Santa Catarina. Other candidates trail with lower percentages, while undecided voters account for 13%.

item.title: PT quer que Lula endureça tom sobre Lulinha e Marcola para se distanciar de potencial escândalo
item.description: The PT urges Lula to toughen his stance on investigations involving his son Lulinha to distance himself from a potential scandal. Despite the president's resistance, the campaign sees a firmer position as necessary ahead of his Jornal Nacional interview. Meanwhile, the PT attacks Flávio Bolsonaro over alleged misused funds for the Dark Horse film.

item.title: Paes lidera todos os cenários na disputa pelo governo do Rio, aponta Quaest
item.description: A Quaest poll shows Eduardo Paes (PSD) leading all scenarios in the Rio de Janeiro governor's race, with 37% of voting intentions against 14% for state deputy Douglas Ruas (PL) in a first-round scenario. Former governor Anthony Garotinho also appears among the names mentioned in the survey. As a Lula ally, Paes consolidates his frontrunner status in the state race.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula estão tecnicamente empatados no RJ, diz Quaest
item.description: A Quaest poll released on Tuesday (Aug. 25) shows Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) technically tied in Rio de Janeiro, with 33% and 31% of voting intentions, respectively. The difference is within the margin of error of up to 3 percentage points. The survey interviewed 1,302 people between Aug. 21 and 24, with a 95% confidence level.

item.title: Como está a disputa pela Presidência em SP, Minas e outros 3 estados, segundo a Quaest
item.description: The August 2026 Quaest poll shows a statistical tie in the Presidential race in São Paulo, Minas Gerais, and Rio de Janeiro, with Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula alternating slight advantages. The survey reveals a highly polarized first-round scenario across the country's main electoral colleges.

item.title: Janja rebate fala de Renan Santos e diz que candidato ridiculariza mulheres
item.description: Janja Lula da Silva rebutted a statement by Renan Santos, who claimed Lula missed the debate because he needed to stay with her. She criticized the candidate for mocking women.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Quaest mostra empate triplo em disputa ao Senado em SP
item.description: A Quaest poll released on August 25 shows a technical three-way tie in the São Paulo Senate race: Guilherme Derrite (PP) and Marina Silva (Rede) have 12% each, while Simone Tebet (PSB) has 11%, all within the two-point margin of error. In the gubernatorial race, incumbent Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) leads with 40%, followed by Fernando Haddad (PT) at 27%.

item.title: Walter Salles doa R$ 100 mil para campanha de neto de Rubens Paiva
item.description: Filmmaker Walter Salles donated R$100,000 to the campaign of Chico Rubens Paiva, grandson of former deputy Rubens Paiva, who is running for federal deputy in Rio de Janeiro for PSB. Salles also contributed R$100,000 to Manuela d'Ávila's Senate campaign in Rio Grande do Sul and R$50,000 each to Vilma Reis (PT-BA) and Abidan Henrique (PSB-SP). The donations, registered with the TSE, reflect the director's political engagement following the success of his Oscar-winning film 'I'm Still Here.'

item.title: No RS, 5 candidatos empatam em disputa pelo Senado, diz Quaest
item.description: A Quaest poll released on August 24, 2026 shows a technical tie among five candidates competing for two Senate seats in Rio Grande do Sul. Manuela d'Ávila (Psol) leads numerically with 12%, followed by Paulo Pimenta (PT) and Marcel van Hattem (Novo) at 9% each, and Ubiratan Sanderson (PL) and Germano Rigotto (MDB) at 8% each. The survey interviewed 900 voters, has a margin of error of 3 percentage points, and is registered with the TSE under number RS-06875/2026.

item.title: MP Eleitoral endossa pedido do Novo para barrar sindicalista ‘candidato de Lula’ a deputado por SP
item.description: The Electoral Public Ministry of São Paulo endorsed a request from the Novo party to block the congressional candidacy of Moisés Selerges (PT), former president of the ABC Metalworkers Union and considered Lula's candidate. The electoral prosecutor ruled that Selerges did not step down from his position within the legal deadline required by electoral law. Selerges's defense contests the challenge, arguing that the union is not funded by public resources and therefore no disqualification period was required.

item.title: O desempenho de Michelle Bolsonaro em disputa ao Senado no DF, segundo pesquisa Quaest
item.description: A Quaest poll released on August 25 shows Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) leading the race for a Senate seat in the Federal District with 25% of voting intentions. She is eight points ahead of Leila do Vôlei (PDT) at 17%, followed by Erika Kokay (PT) at 12% and Bia Kicis (PL) at 9%, in a scenario with 12% blank/null votes and 18% undecided voters. The survey interviewed 1,104 voters in the Federal District between August 21 and 24, with a margin of error of 3 percentage points.

item.title: Quaest: Tarcísio lidera em SP com 40%, contra 27% de Haddad
item.description: A Quaest poll released on Tuesday (25) shows Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) leading the re-election race in São Paulo with 40% of voting intentions. Fernando Haddad (PT) comes in second with 27%. The remaining candidates — Edjane (Agir), Vera Lúcia (PSTU), Carlos Machado (PCB), Izadora Dias (PCO), and Vivian Mendes (UP) — register marginal percentages, between 1% and 2%.

item.title: Lula tem 54% contra 19% de Flávio Bolsonaro em Pernambuco, diz Quaest
item.description: A Quaest poll shows Lula leading the presidential race in Pernambuco by a wide margin, with 54% of voting intentions versus 19% for Flávio Bolsonaro in the first scenario. In the second scenario, which includes Pablo Marçal, Lula rises to 55%, while Flávio Bolsonaro remains in second place with 19%. The survey, commissioned by Rede Globo, interviewed 1,302 people and has a margin of error of 3 percentage points.

item.title: Lula reforça time jurídico com dois ex-ministros do TSE
item.description: President Lula's (PT) reelection campaign has strengthened its legal team by hiring lawyers and brothers Henrique Neves and Fernando Neves, both former TSE justices. The decision was confirmed by the campaign's legal coordinator, Angelo Ferraro, to O Antagonista. The move is part of the PT's strategy to bolster its team ahead of the 2026 electoral disputes.

item.title: Quaest: em MG, Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula empatam no 1º turno
item.description: A Quaest poll in Minas Gerais shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) in the presidential race. Without Pablo Marçal, Flávio leads numerically with 31% versus 30% for Lula; with Marçal running, both reach 31%. The margin of error is three percentage points with a 95% confidence level.

item.title: Daniela Lima: Caso Lulinha mostra que governo Lula não tem zagueiro
item.description: Columnist Daniela Lima stated on UOL News that the case involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, exposed a 'every man for himself' strategy within the Planalto. According to her, the situation reinforces the assessment that the Lula government 'has no defender' to contain political crises.

item.title: Pesquisa Quaest mostra a distância entre Lula e Flávio no maior colégio eleitoral do Brasil
item.description: A Quaest poll shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (30%) and Lula (29%) in São Paulo, within the two-point margin of error. The two candidates together hold 59% of voting intentions, leading the third-place Renan Santos (5%) by at least 24 points. A quarter of São Paulo voters remain undecided or plan to vote blank/null.

item.title: Quaest: Lula tem 28% das intenções de voto e empata com Flávio no DF
item.description: Incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leads with 28% of voting intentions in the Federal District, tying technically with Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), who reached 26%. The Quaest poll, commissioned by Globo, surveyed 1,104 voters between August 21 and 24, with a margin of error of 3 percentage points.

item.title: Flávio prestigia vice em estreia no Nordeste, mas atos expõem distância de aliados em Alagoas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro launched his campaign in the Northeast with a focus on Alagoas, but faced resistance from local allies like JHC and Arthur Lira, who avoid strong ties to the presidential race to preserve their electoral space in a tight gubernatorial contest.

item.title: Justiça preserva dados, mas não derruba vídeo de Flávio sobre Lulinha
item.description: A São Paulo court ordered social media platforms to preserve data from a video by Flávio Bolsonaro linking Lulinha to INSS fraud schemes, but did not order its removal. The judge ruled there is insufficient evidence at this stage to assess the video's veracity. Lulinha is seeking R$ 10,000 in damages and the removal of the posts.

item.title: Quaest em SP: 56% aprovam e 31% desaprovam governo de Tarcísio de Freitas
item.description: A Quaest poll commissioned by Globo shows 56% of São Paulo residents approve of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas' administration, while 31% disapprove. The survey interviewed 1,800 people between August 21-24, with a two-percentage-point margin of error.

item.title: Benedito Gonçalves, do STJ, assume corregedoria nacional de Justiça
item.description: STJ Minister Benedito Gonçalves was sworn in on Tuesday (25) as the new national corrector of Justice at the CNJ, serving until 2028. Approved by the Senate with 53 votes in favor, he will be responsible for analyzing disciplinary complaints against judges and overseeing courts, with a preventive approach. Gonçalves has an extensive career in the judiciary, notable for anti-racism initiatives and for serving as rapporteur at the TSE in the conviction of Jair Bolsonaro for abuse of power in the 2022 elections.

item.title: Moraes autoriza professor particular a entrar na casa de Bolsonaro para dar aulas à filha do ex-presidente
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes temporarily authorized a teacher to enter former President Jair Bolsonaro's residence to provide private tutoring to his daughter Laura Bolsonaro. The permission was granted for one specific day, and Moraes ordered Bolsonaro's defense to report weekly class schedules for potential regular authorization. The former president is under house arrest after being convicted on corruption charges.

item.title: Lula empata com Flávio Bolsonaro em Minas Gerais, diz Quaest
item.description: Quaest poll in Minas Gerais shows a technical tie between Lula (30-31%) and Flávio Bolsonaro (31%) in both first-round scenarios tested for 2026. The survey interviewed 1,506 voters between August 21-24, with a 3 percentage point margin of error.

item.title: Veja o que é #FATO ou #FAKE na sabatina de Romeu Zema ao GLOBO, Valor e CBN
item.description: Presidential candidate Romeu Zema (Novo) participated in an interview hosted by O Globo, Valor, and CBN, where two main statements were fact-checked by Fato ou Fake. His claim that Brazil remains dependent on importing diesel and gasoline was classified as #FACT, based on ANP data showing increased imports in 2025. However, his statement that there were no scandals or fraud during his government in Minas Gerais was debunked and classified as #FAKE, due to the Federal Police's Operation Rejeito, which uncovered a corruption scheme involving fraudulent environmental mining licenses.

item.title: Prefeito do PSB ignora chapa Haddad-França e adere a campanha de Tarcísio
item.description: Akira Auriani, mayor of Rio Grande da Serra and member of the PSB, broke ranks with the Haddad-France ticket and endorsed Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) in the São Paulo gubernatorial race. The move is awkward for the PSB, since Márcio França, Haddad's running mate, belongs to the same party as the mayor.

item.title: Justiça nega pedido de Lulinha para remover vídeo de Flávio que o vincula a fraudes no INSS
item.description: The São Paulo Justice denied Lulinha's request to remove a video by Flávio Bolsonaro linking him to INSS fraud. The judge ruled that the defense failed to provide sufficient evidence of the content's falsity, while ordering the preservation of post data.

item.title: Tarcísio tem 40% e Haddad, 27% no 1º turno em SP, diz Quaest
item.description: Quaest poll released on August 25, 2026 shows Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) leading the São Paulo gubernatorial race with 40% of first-round voting intentions, against 27% for Fernando Haddad (PT). In a runoff scenario between the two, Tarcísio has 47% and Haddad 30%. The survey interviewed 1,800 voters from August 21-24, with a 2-point margin of error.

item.title: Lula e Flávio têm 30% dos votos cada um no 1º turno em SP
item.description: A Quaest poll in São Paulo shows a technical tie between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, both with 30% of voting intentions in the first round, within a 2 percentage point margin of error. Pablo Marçal comes third with 4%, followed by Renan Santos and Ronaldo Caiado with 3% each. The survey interviewed 1,800 people and is registered with the TSE.

item.title: Haddad critica taxa de juros e promete ‘BNDES estadual’ em evento com a indústria
item.description: Fernando Haddad criticized the high interest rate and advocated for the creation of a state BNDES to boost infrastructure investments in São Paulo. He participated in a forum organized by ABDIB, highlighting the tax reform as beneficial to the state and rejecting criticisms of the federal government.

item.title: Diretor de 'Ainda estou aqui' doa R$ 100 mil para campanha de neto de Rubens Paiva
item.description: Oscar-winning director Walter Salles donated R$100,000 to the campaign of Chico Rubens Paiva (PSB-RJ), grandson of Rubens and Eunice Paiva, who is running for a seat in the Chamber of Deputies. The amount represents one-third of the declared donations from the Itaú heir reported to the TSE so far.

item.title: Candidata à Presidência cobra Cármen Lúcia: “Se omite com as mulheres”
item.description: Presidential candidate Clariana Barão criticized STF minister Cármen Lúcia for remaining silent on the absence of women in the Band's presidential debate. The Democracia Cristã filed a motion questioning selection criteria and requesting Barão's inclusion, but the TSE rejected the plea.

item.title: Juliana Brizola lidera disputa ao governo do RS, diz pesquisa
item.description: A TSE-registered poll by Real Time Big Data shows that Juliana Brizola (PDT) leads the race for Rio Grande do Sul governor with 38% of first-round vote intentions, followed by Zucco (PL) at 32%. In all head-to-head second-round scenarios tested, the matchups result in technical ties, keeping the race competitive.

item.title: “Alcolumbre tem obsessão por jogos de azar”, diz Girão
item.description: In an interview with Poder360, Senator Eduardo Girão (Novo-CE), running mate of presidential candidate Romeu Zema, accused Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União Brasil-AP) of being 'obsessed' with the legalization of gambling in Brazil. Girão claimed Alcolumbre orchestrated the replacement of four opposing senators on the CCJ to push through bill PL 2.234/2022, which legalizes casinos, bingo, 'jogo do bicho,' and horse race betting. Girão also called for a ban on online betting platforms, blaming them for rising household debt and negative economic impacts.

item.title: Haddad critica Sabesp: “Evitar que vire Enel das águas”
item.description: Haddad criticized the privatization of Sabesp and advocated for public intervention to prevent the company from becoming an 'Enel of water.' He highlighted issues with supply and safety at Enel as an example, warning of the fiscal strain on the state. For Haddad, balancing public finances is essential for sustainable growth.

item.title: Haddad diz que segundo turno em SP é ‘matematicamente inviável’ e admite desafio eleitoral
item.description: Fernando Haddad (PT) acknowledged a second round in São Paulo is "mathematically impossible" due to polarization with Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) and centrão's support for the governor. Haddad will focus on education, security, and health over the next 50 days, criticizing Tarcísio's fiscal management for turning a surplus into a deficit.

item.title: Zema acusa Amoêdo de tentar “se apropriar” do Novo “para finalidades pessoais”
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) rebutted criticism from party founder João Amoêdo, accusing him of trying to appropriate the party for personal purposes. The disagreement arose after Zema's participation in the Jornal Nacional sabatina.

item.title: Tarcísio de Freitas é confundido com galã de novelas em evento
item.description: During a Metropolitan Civil Guard event on violence against women, São Paulo governor Tarcísio de Freitas was mistakenly introduced as 'Tarcísio Meira' by the master of ceremonies, confusing him with the famous TV Globo actor who died in 2021. The mistake was corrected minutes later, and Tarcísio joked about the mix-up, saying he wished he had been born looking like Tom Cruise. The episode is a light note with no direct political impact.

item.title: JHC e Renan Filho empatam no 2º turno em Alagoas, diz Quaest
item.description: A Quaest poll released on Aug 24, 2026 shows a technical tie between Renan Filho (MDB) and JHC (PSDB) in a hypothetical 2nd round for the Alagoas state government, both with 42% of voting intentions. In the 1st round, Renan Filho leads with 42%, followed by JHC at 40%. The survey, registered with the TSE, interviewed 804 voters with a margin of error of 3 percentage points.

item.title: Campanha de Lula define estratégia para tentar atrair voto evangélico
item.description: Lula's campaign defines strategy to attract evangelical votes by focusing on social and economic policies, avoiding ideological debates with Bolsonarism. The approach includes actions outside churches and promotes measures like the end of the 6×1 workweek, highlighting benefits for families and women.

item.title: Advogado de Lulinha reclama de vazamentos à PF e quer falar com ministros do STF
item.description: Lawyer Marco Aurélio de Carvalho, who represents Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, complained to Justice Minister Wellington César Silva and Federal Police director-general Andrei Rodrigues about leaks of information from investigations targeting President Lula's son. The attorney also intends to speak with Supreme Court justices about the matter.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que “sempre vai ter dependente químico na rua”
item.description: São Paulo Governor and reelection candidate Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) stated that there will 'always be drug addicts on the streets' and that the Cracolândia was not eliminated but rather spread across the city. He defended the state government's actions against crack cocaine, including opening hospital beds and therapeutic houses. His opponent Fernando Haddad (PT) also criticized the administration, claiming that drug use has simply dispersed to other regions of the capital.
